## Problem Being Addressed
A clear and concise description of the friction, limitation, or problem. Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

## Expected Benefit
Describe how this enhancement improves the event experience for hackathon participants, mentors, or event operators.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
